name: will-power-fitness-native
description: Capacitor wrapper that packages the Will Power Fitness web app as an iPhone app. UNVERIFIED scaffold.

scripts.ios:sync: npm run sync-web && npx cap sync ios
scripts.ios:setup: gem install xcodeproj --user-install && npm install && npm run sync-web && npx cap add ios && npm run ios:healthkit && npx cap sync ios
